note: Five-scene narrative arc of the divided kingdom, split to exile. Images are original CFM Corner Moedim artwork.

panels.title: The Split
panels.caption: At Shechem the ten northern tribes reject Rehoboam's harsh answer and follow Jeroboam. The kingdom tears in two — Israel in the north, Judah in the south.

panels.title: The Golden Calves
panels.caption: To keep his people from worshipping in Jerusalem, Jeroboam sets up golden calves at Dan and Bethel — “the sin of Jeroboam” that will measure every northern king.

panels.title: Fire on Carmel
panels.caption: In the North's darkest years God sends his greatest prophets. Elijah calls down fire on Carmel, standing against Ahab, Jezebel, and the Baal cult.

panels.title: Samaria Falls
panels.caption: In 722 BC Assyria breaches Samaria and carries the ten tribes away. The northern kingdom is scattered into exile — and into legend as the “lost tribes.”

panels.title: The Exile
panels.caption: In 586 BC Babylon burns Jerusalem and the temple, and leads Judah away captive. The fracture that began at Shechem ends in the long night of exile.
